verdict.rationale: Graphite documents its own reviewer customization: custom rules give Graphite Agent explicit review guidelines, comment exclusions say where it should not comment, and paid plans list "AI Review customizations." That covers the instruction-configuration part of the story. The evidence never says these settings live in a versioned config file in the repo, and the docs stress "no configuration required." Missing for 10: a documented in-repo versioned config file, path filters, per-path instructions, review profiles, and any hands-on corroboration.
